```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr) #installing tidyr so I can use the pivot_longer() function
library(ggthemes) #installing ggthemes so that I can use the minimal theme for my line graph
```

```{r}
data1 <- data425 %>% filter(Grade=="All Grades")
data1$'% Attendance' <- as.numeric(data1$'% Attendance')
```

```{r}
data1

```

```{r}
ggplot(data1, aes(x = Year, y = data1$'% Attendance', fill = Category)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "dodge") +
  labs(
    #title = "Different Economic Groups' % Attendance from 2016-2021",
    x = "Year", y = "% Attendance") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#ff8800", "#236290"))+
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(85, 95)) +
  theme_classic()
#(axis.line = element_line(color = "black", size = 0.5))
```
```{r}
model <- lm(`% Attendance` ~ Category, data = data1)
summary(model)
```
```{r}
data2 <- read_xlsx("Change in how households with children received education due to the coronavirus pandemic.xlsx") %>% filter(Location=="New York")
data2$Data[data2$Data=="S"] <- "0"
data2
```

```{r}
ggplot(data2, aes(x = TimeFrame, y = Data, fill = COVIDImpactEduc)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "dodge") +
  labs(title = "Teaching styles throughout COVID", x = "Time", y = "%") +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 1)) + 
  theme(axis.line = element_line(color = "black", size = 0.5))#+
  #scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.1))
```



```{r}
data3<-read_xlsx("demographic-snapshot-2019-20-to-2023-24-public.xlsx",sheet="District")
data3_racialdemographics <- data3 %>% filter(Year=="2019-20") 
data3_racialdemographics
```
```{r}
data3_racialdemographics_cleaned <- data3_racialdemographics[c( 
"Administrative District",
'% Asian',
'% Black',
'% Hispanic',
'% Multi-Racial',
'% Native American',
'% White',
'% Missing Race/Ethnicity Data',
"Economic Need Index")] 

data3_racialdemographics_cleaned1 <- data3_racialdemographics_cleaned %>% mutate(across(where(is.numeric),~.*100)) %>% mutate(across(where(is.numeric),~round(.,1))) %>% arrange(`Economic Need Index`) 
data3_racialdemographics_cleaned1
```

```{r}
data4<-read_xlsx("demographic-snapshot-2019-20-to-2023-24-public.xlsx",sheet="Citywide")
data4_racialdemographics <- data4 %>% filter(Year=="2019-20") 
data4_racialdemographics
```
```{r}
data4_racialdemographics_cleaned <- data4_racialdemographics[c( 
'% Asian',
'% Black',
'% Hispanic',
'% Multi-Racial',
'% Native American',
'% White',
'% Missing Race/Ethnicity Data',
"Economic Need Index")] 
data4_racialdemographics_cleaned1 <- data4_racialdemographics_cleaned <- data4_racialdemographics_cleaned %>%
    arrange(`Economic Need Index`) %>% mutate_all(~.*100) %>% mutate(across(where(is.numeric),~round(.,1)))
data4_racialdemographics_cleaned1
```
```{r}
data4_racialdemographics_cleaned1$`% Asian`
```

```{r}
data5 <- data3_racialdemographics_cleaned1 %>% mutate(across('% Asian', ~.-data4_racialdemographics_cleaned1$`% Asian`)) %>% mutate(across('% Black', ~.-data4_racialdemographics_cleaned1$`% Black`))  %>% mutate(across('% Hispanic', ~.-data4_racialdemographics_cleaned1$`% Hispanic`)) %>% mutate(across('% Multi-Racial', ~.-data4_racialdemographics_cleaned1$`% Multi-Racial`)) %>% mutate(across('% Native American', ~.-data4_racialdemographics_cleaned1$`% Native American`)) %>% mutate(across('% White', ~.-data4_racialdemographics_cleaned1$`% White`))
data5
```
